summary: The final change restores full copying on first creation and leaves reopened worktrees unchanged. R3-1 and R3-2 are resolved as regressions; F1–F4 and R2-1 remain fixed. The work order accurately records R2-2 as a pre-existing low-severity limit. No medium-or-higher finding is open. This was a read-only review; the full-suite log predates HEAD.

acceptance_criteria.basis: First creation copies complete sources without skipping existing destinations; reopen no longer attempts a partial repair. The remaining failed-copy retry behavior is the recorded R2-2 limit.
Name and path checks, linked-worktree validation, and the single-path stdout contract remain in the hook and tests.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No regression against 2.4.1 in Bash 3.2, stdout, failure paths, or copying
acceptance_criteria.basis: The copy logic matches the baseline behavior; the round-4 evidence reports 28 Bash 3.2 tests passing. No tests were run during this review.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: R2-2 is described accurately in the work order
acceptance_criteria.basis: The work order states that a post-creation copy failure leaves a registered worktree and that reopening does not complete the copy.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WO criterion 1: create a worktree in a repository without a VibeOS marker
acceptance_criteria.basis: The scope guard is removed, and the hook creates the named branch and prints its absolute path.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WO criterion 2: head uses the current HEAD
acceptance_criteria.basis: The head mode resolves HEAD; the test covers an unpushed commit.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WO criterion 3: fresh uses origin default branch, otherwise HEAD
acceptance_criteria.basis: The hook verifies origin/HEAD and falls back to HEAD.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WO criterion 4: settings precedence and malformed settings
acceptance_criteria.basis: The hook reads local, project, then user settings and skips malformed files.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WO criterion 5: reopen an existing worktree
acceptance_criteria.basis: A registered, usable linked worktree is returned without copying.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WO criterion 6: reject invalid names and non-repository cwd with empty stdout
acceptance_criteria.basis: Both paths fail before the sole stdout print; tests cover them.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WO criterion 7: preserve VibeOS manifest and .worktreeinclude copying and the WO-117 test
acceptance_criteria.basis: First-creation copying matches the baseline, and the relevant tests and round-4 test evidence are present.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WO criterion 8: full suite, bash -n, WO lint, and index validation pass
acceptance_criteria.basis: The recorded full-suite run identifies 89fdca7, before the final commit. Tests and gates were not run during this read-only review.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WO criterion 9: cross-vendor review passes and its receipt is recorded
acceptance_criteria.basis: This confirmation review passes, but its receipt was not recorded because the review was required to be read-only.
